title: SpoolRecord
description: One Claude Code hook event, written by `muretto hook <event>` to ~/.muretto/spool/ and nothing else. Already capped and redacted when written. Local only: never synced.

event.description: Hook event name, e.g. SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, SubagentStart, SessionEnd.

session_id.description: The Claude Code session id (a UUID).

agent_id.description: Set when the event fired inside a subagent.

source.description: SessionStart source: startup, resume, clear, compact, fork.

title_candidate.description: UserPromptSubmit only: the first line of the prompt, redacted and truncated. The full prompt is never stored.

tool_input.description: Redacted, size-capped copy of the tool input.

tool_response.description: Redacted, size-capped copy of the tool response.

error.description: PostToolUseFailure error text, redacted and capped.

truncated.description: True when any field was cut to fit the size cap.

child_session.description: CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION was set in the hook environment.

extra_keys.description: Names (not values) of top-level stdin keys this version didn't recognise, so schema drift is visible.
